## Overview

This 2026-09-15-captured Zip for iOS page is an integration **chooser**. It links to Zip iOS Drop-in and Components child guides and to general iOS Sessions-flow Drop-in/Components guides. It does not itself specify payment request fields, region or currency eligibility, redirect completion, recurring setup, or payment results. See [[adyen]] and [[adyen-online-payments]].

## Key takeaways

- The Zip iOS Drop-in child link is described as an all-in-one UI solution; the Components child link is described as a Redirect Component (raw lines 19–27).
- The page's final “more information” links point to general iOS Drop-in and Components **Sessions-flow** integration guides (raw line 29). This chooser link does not by itself define the flows supported by each Zip child guide.
- Use the linked child guide and general integration guide for detailed prerequisites and behavior. The chooser alone is no evidence of current merchant enablement or successful payment execution.

## Detail locators

- Zip iOS identity and child route descriptions: raw `# Zip for iOS` lines 15–27.
- General iOS Sessions-flow guide links: raw line 29.
